description.value: Shawn's Chicken (also known as Yongshun Fried Chicken / 永顺炸鸡) is a Richmond fast food restaurant serving a Beijing-origin style of fried chicken marinated in over 20 Chinese herbs before deep frying. The restaurant emphasizes daily-fresh, never-frozen chicken that comes out golden, crispy, and juicy. Located in a Richmond plaza, it offers combo meals, family packs, and sides — a potential calorie stop for cyclists on the Richmond cycling network.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and active, confirming the business is a fast food fried chicken restaurant in Richmond. The website lists a unit number of 1300 while OSM records unit 1295 — a discrepancy flagged below. The website confirms the phone number (604-998-6618) not present in OSM, and the 'ORDER NOW!' call-to-action plus fast_food OSM tag support a takeout value of true.
